description: Audit a multi-session weekly hybrid schedule (timestamped strength and endurance sessions) for AMPK-mTOR proximity interference (`<3h` high / `3–6h` moderate), `36h` long-run glycogen depletion before lower-body lifting, `48h` heavy-hinge CNS fatigue before speed runs, and Seiler `80/20` intensity drift. Stateless public calculator (no auth required). Use for cross-modal weekly scheduling conflicts; to audit per-muscle lifting set volume without endurance timing, use `volume_audit` instead.

priority.description: Optional block priority (`strength` or `endurance`) weighting conflict penalties.

sessions.description: Timestamped weekly strength and endurance sessions to check for cross-modal conflicts.

distance_km.description: Optional endurance distance in kilometers (triggers long-run glycogen rules).

explosive.description: True when targeting RFD/plyometric power sensitive to residual fatigue.

hinge.description: True when the session includes heavy axial hip-hinge work (deadlifts, RDLs, heavy sleds).

id.description: Optional caller-defined session identifier echoed in findings.

intensity.description: Effort tier (`easy`/`moderate`/`hard` for endurance; `light`/`moderate`/`heavy` for strength).

lower_body.description: True when a strength session loads quads, glutes, hamstrings, or calves.

max_test.description: True for 1RM tests or A-priority race/time-trial efforts.

cns_score.description: Composite central nervous system recovery strain score.

connect_url.description: URL to connect a stateful STRUGGL athlete ledger via OAuth 2.1 or token.

findings.description: Detected physiological rule violations with affected session pairs and fixes.

findings_summary.description: Counts of detected conflicts grouped by severity.

methodology.description: Peer-reviewed sports-science equation and STRUGGL pillar provenance.

onboarding.description: OAuth 2.1 connector metadata explaining what longitudinal state unlocking adds.

recommendations.description: Actionable session-reordering fixes to eliminate interference.

tax_pct.description: Estimated concurrent adaptation interference penalty percentage.
